background_description: The background shows an Egyptian temple or tomb setting with stone walls and hieroglyphic carvings. Intense fire and flame effects dominate the entire screen, creating a blazing inferno atmosphere around the reels.

name: Gemix
description: Gemix is a cascading cluster-pays slot played on a 7x7 grid where players progress through different magical worlds by clearing patterns. The crystal charge meter fills with wins and triggers powerful transformation effects, with the potential for 3x multipliers when super charged.

symbols.name: Miner's World Wild
symbols.description: Wild symbols that drop down from the top and land on different positions, replacing regular symbols. Up to 10 can appear. Substitutes for any other symbol and removed when part of winning combination.

symbols.name: Princess' World Wild
symbols.description: Wild symbol that starts from an edge position and spreads to adjacent symbols until reaching another edge. Substitutes for any other symbol and removed when part of winning combination.

symbols.name: Wizard's World Sticky Wild
symbols.description: Sticky wild symbols that don't drop down when symbols below are removed and aren't removed when part of winning combinations. Up to 8 can appear and stay for one game round or until Crystal Charge is triggered.

feature_details.name: Cascading Reels
feature_details.context: Game Rules section - 'Symbols drop down in the grid to form winning combinations. Wins are achieved by getting 5 or more symbols in a connected cluster... Winning symbols are removed and new symbols drop in to fill up the grid.'
feature_details.description: After wins, winning symbols are removed and new symbols fall into the gaps, creating chain wins until no more wins can be formed.

feature_details.name: Persistence
feature_details.context: Game Rules section - 'All wins during a game round contribute to increasing a crystal charge meter. When the crystal charge meter is fully charged and there are no more cascades, the crystal charge effect is activated'
feature_details.description: A crystal charge meter fills progressively from wins across the game round and persists until fully charged, then triggers special effects.

feature_details.name: Symbol Transformation
feature_details.context: Game Rules section describing Chain Lightning, Light Beam, Crystal Warp effects - 'These symbols are transformed into one of the corner symbols', 'All symbols in the affected column and row are transformed to other symbols', 'all matching symbols are warped to other symbols'
feature_details.description: When crystal charge meter fills, one of four transformation effects triggers: Chain Lightning transforms hit symbols, Light Beam transforms entire rows/columns, Crystal Warp transforms matching symbols, or Nova Blast removes and creates symbol cores.

feature_details.name: Trail Bonus
feature_details.context: Game Rules section - 'Gemix includes different worlds. Each world is assigned three different patterns... To clear a pattern you have to achieve wins on the indicated grid positions. Clearing a pattern activates the next pattern... If you clear three patterns in a world, you reach the next world and you are awarded the World Bonus.'
feature_details.description: Players progress through different worlds by clearing three patterns per world, with each cleared world awarding a World Bonus that increases with wins.

background_description: The background shows a mystical underwater or cosmic scene with blue-teal tones, featuring what appears to be stone pillars or structures on the left side, with a dreamy, ethereal atmosphere throughout.

Free Spins include guaranteed stacked Random Wild Multipliers with values up to 15x.

name: Charming Lady Win Ways

symbols.name: Bonus

symbols.name: Green Keycard

symbols.name: Blue Keycard

symbols.name: Red Keycard

symbols.name: Powerblock safe

symbols.name: Powerblock activation symbol

symbols.name: Wild Multiplier

background_description: Urban cityscape background with buildings and skyscrapers visible behind the game interface panels.

background_description: The background shows a vibrant cosmic space scene with swirling purple and pink nebulae, scattered stars, and cosmic dust clouds creating a deep space atmosphere.

description: Bust the Mansion is a 5-reel, 3-row money-themed slot with 25 fixed paylines. feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: Triggered by stacked wilds fully covering both reels 1 and 5, commencing a sequence of free spins where reels 1 and 5 remain stacked with wild symbols throughout the entire feature.
characteristics: No additional free spins awarded during feature

feature_details.name: Pick Bonus
feature_details.description: Three bonus symbols anywhere on the reels triggers this bonus where you select one of the bonus symbols to reveal the prize won.
characteristics: Select one symbol to reveal prize

feature_details.name: Gamble Feature
feature_details.description: Optional feature to multiply prizes by correctly guessing the color or suit of a face-down card. Color guess doubles the prize, suit guess quadruples it.

feature_details.name: Stacked Symbols
feature_details.description: The ship symbol appears as stacked wilds that can fully cover reels, substituting for any other reel symbol except the chest.
characteristics: Substitutes for all symbols except chest

name: Cat Wilde In The Eclipse Of The Sun God
description: Cat Wilde in the Eclipse of the Sun God is a 5x3 cascading slot with 20 fixed paylines featuring progressive win multipliers and free spins. Win multipliers increase on cascades up to x10 in base game and x70 during free spins, triggered by 3 scatter symbols.

symbols.name: Sun God
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except scatters, lands on reels 2-4 in main game and anywhere during free spins

symbols.name: Moon Goddess
symbols.description: Triggers free spins when 3 land on reels 1, 3, and 5, acts as wild during free spins, collecting 5 during free spins awards additional spins

feature_details.name: Cascading Reels
feature_details.description: Winning symbols are removed and new symbols fill up the reel. Cascades continue until no more wins can be created.

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: 3 SCATTERS landing on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger 10 initial FREE SPINS. During FREE SPINS, collect 5 Moon Goddess SCATTERS for additional 5 spins up to maximum of 40.
characteristics: Scatters act as wilds during feature

feature_details.name: Multiplier
feature_details.description: Win multiplier raises on cascades up to x10 in base game and up to x70 during FREE SPINS. Multiplier upgrades when collecting Moon Goddess scatters during free spins.
characteristics: Up to x10 in base game
Up to x70 in free spins

name: Jolly Roger
description: Jolly Roger is a 5-reel pirate-themed video slot with up to 15 paylines featuring wild symbols that double wins, scatter pays, and two bonus rounds - the Treasure Chest and Treasure Map bonuses triggered by landing 3+ respective symbols on active lines.

symbols.name: Wild (Jolly Roger)
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except parrot, map and chest. Doubles the prize when part of a winning combination.

symbols.name: Scatter (Parrot)
symbols.description: Two or more scatter symbols anywhere on the reels constitute a win.

symbols.name: Chest
symbols.description: Three or more chest symbols on any active line trigger the Treasure Chest bonus round.

symbols.name: Map
symbols.description: Three or more map symbols on any active line trigger the Treasure Map bonus round. Only appears on reels 1, 2 and 3.

feature_details.name: Pick Bonus
feature_details.description: Three or more chest symbols on any active line trigger the Treasure Chest bonus round where players pick from items to reveal prizes.

feature_details.name: Pick Bonus
feature_details.description: Three or more map symbols on any active line trigger the Treasure Map bonus round. Map symbols only appear on reels 1, 2 and 3.

feature_details.name: Multiplier
feature_details.description: A winning combination that includes a wild symbol pays double the normal prize.

name: Creepy Christmas
description: Creepy Christmas is a 5x4 video slot played on 40 paylines featuring a Hot Zone mechanic on reel 3. The game combines Christmas and horror themes with a Free Spins feature triggered by landing a snow globe scatter in the Hot Zone.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Scatters

symbols.name: Lady Santa Wild
symbols.description: Appears only on reel 3 and acts as a wild in the hot zone, triggers Lady Santa's Skulls feature when landing in Hot Zone

symbols.name: Snow Globe Scatter
symbols.description: Awards Free Spins feature when 1 symbol lands inside the Hot Zone on reel 3

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: Free Spins feature is awarded when 1 snow globe Scatter lands inside the Hot Zone on reel 3. Special reels are in play during the Free Games Feature.
characteristics: triggered by scatter in hot zone
hot zone active during free spins

name: Bakers Treat
description: Baker's Treat is a 5-reel British-themed slot with collection meters for different cake symbols. Each cake type has its own Flour Power feature with unique mechanics like wild reels, expanding wilds, and symbol unification. The Bake Off feature combines all mechanics when triggered by landing all cake symbols simultaneously.

symbols.name: Cupcake
symbols.description: High pay cake symbol associated with reel 1, triggers synchronized reels feature

symbols.name: Blueberry Pie
symbols.description: High pay cake symbol associated with reel 2, triggers wild reel feature

symbols.name: Carrot Cake
symbols.description: High pay cake symbol associated with reel 3

symbols.name: Lemon Cheesecake
symbols.description: High pay cake symbol associated with reel 4, triggers expanding wilds feature

symbols.name: Strawberry Sponge
symbols.description: High pay cake symbol associated with reel 5, triggers symbol unification feature

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for other symbols, can expand during Lemon Cheesecake feature

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.operator_name: Flour Power Features / Bake Off Feature
feature_details.context: Multiple sections describing Flour Power Features and Bake Off Feature
feature_details.description: Various cake symbols trigger different types of free spins when their collection meters fill up with 3 tokens. The Bake Off feature combines all Flour Power features in sequence.
characteristics: Collection meter fills from stacked symbols

feature_details.name: Persistence
feature_details.context: Game Rules section describing collection meters above reels
feature_details.description: Each high pay cake symbol has an associated reel with a collection meter that accumulates tokens across base game spins. When 3 tokens are collected, the corresponding Flour Power Feature is triggered.
characteristics: Tokens collected when stacked symbols fill reels
Average stake calculation from contributing spins

feature_details.name: Wild Reels
feature_details.context: Game Rules section describing Blueberry Pie feature
feature_details.description: The Blueberry Pie Flour Power Feature awards three free spins where 1 entire reel becomes Wild.
characteristics: Part of Flour Power feature system

feature_details.name: Expanding Wilds
feature_details.context: Game Rules section describing Lemon Cheesecake feature
feature_details.description: The Lemon Cheesecake Flour Power Feature awards three free spins where any regular Wild symbols that appear expand to fill the entire reel.
characteristics: Wilds expand to cover full reel
Only during specific free spins feature

feature_details.name: Symbol Transformation
feature_details.context: Game Rules section describing Strawberry Sponge feature
feature_details.description: The Strawberry Sponge Flour Power Feature unifies all low pay Macaron symbols into one type during three free spins.
characteristics: All low pay symbols become same type

feature_details.name: Stacked Symbols
feature_details.context: Game Rules section describing how cake symbols appear in stacks
feature_details.description: High Pay Cake symbols can appear in stacks on their associated reels during the base game. When they completely fill a reel, tokens are collected.
characteristics: Cake symbols stack on specific reels

feature_details.name: Win Both Ways
feature_details.context: Game Rules section stating game pays left to right and right to left
feature_details.description: Baker's Treat pays both left to right and right to left on its 15 fixed paylines.

name: Mission Cash
description: Mission Cash is a spy-themed 5-reel video slot with 20 paylines featuring a unique Crosshair targeting system. The game includes expandable Wild reels and re-spins triggered when the Crosshair lands on special agent symbols, plus Free Spins with enhanced features.

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: Triggered when the Crosshair lands on a Scatter symbol, awarding 8 Free Spins initially. Can be retriggered for additional 8 Free Spins if Crosshair lands on Scatter during the feature.

feature_details.name: Respin
feature_details.description: When Crosshair lands on Agent Blue or Agent Red, the symbol expands to Wild reel and triggers 1 re-spin. Can chain multiple re-spins until all reels are Wild or Crosshair lands on other symbols.

feature_details.name: Wild Reels
feature_details.description: When Crosshair lands on Agent Blue or Agent Red, the entire reel expands to become Wild and is held for re-spins. Multiple reels can become Wild through the chaining mechanism.

name: Samba Carnival
description: Samba Carnival is a 5-reel video slot that invites you to join the colorful parade in Rio and samba your way to success. The game features wild symbols with 2-5x multipliers, a Bongo bonus round triggered by drum scatters, and an optional gamble feature for additional wins.

symbols.name: Wild (Maracas)
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except scatter and multiplies winning combinations by 2-5x

symbols.name: Scatter (Drums)
symbols.description: Three drum symbols anywhere on reels trigger the Bongo bonus round

feature_details.name: Gamble Feature
feature_details.description: Optional feature that provides an opportunity to multiply the total prize on any spin by correctly guessing the colour or suit of a hidden card. Can be played up to five times in a row for a total prize of up to 2500 coins.

feature_details.name: Multiplier
feature_details.context: Game Rules section - wild symbol description
feature_details.description: The wild symbol (maracas) multiplies the amount of the prize for each winning combination it helps to create by a factor of 2-5.

feature_details.name: Pick Bonus
feature_details.description: When three drum symbols appear anywhere on the reels, the Bongo bonus round begins. Bang on one of the three sets of drums to win up to 150 times your total bet.
